title: Claw Fleet — Your personal AI workspace
description: Give AI the work, review the decisions, and take the results. A personal workspace for Claude Code, Codex and dsh (DeepSeek Harness), with projects, deliverables and mobile access.
headline:
Give it the work.
Make the calls.
Take the results.
lede: Bring Claude Code, Codex and dsh (DeepSeek Harness) together. Move work forward by project, review what needs your judgment, and keep the results within reach.
meta: Free & open source. Bring your own AI tools and accounts.
panelTitles: Start with a task. Or just a conversation.
The material belongs beside the decision.
A result you can open, keep and share.
panelCopy: Choose a project and an AI tool. Add the context, give it a direction, and come back to the same workspace to continue.
Look at a proposal, image or document, then give the task its next direction. Questions and answers stay connected to the work.
Browse deliverables by project. Preview documents and media, add a note, save a favorite, or export the file.
sectionHeading:
Keep the whole
piece of work together.
sectionText: The project, the conversation, the next decision, and what came out of it.
features: Send a follow-up while a Fleet task runs, or continue the conversation once it stops. Your work stays with the project.
Review the material an agent brings back: a proposal, an image, a document. Choose a direction without reconstructing the whole conversation.
Open a deliverable, export it, and return to it later. Keep reusable conclusions in a versioned project wiki.
harnessHeading:
One piece of work.
More than one agent.
harnessCopy: Planning, implementation and review don’t have to run on the same tool. You decide who takes which step.
relayNote: The split is only an example. Every task picks its own tool and model; name another tool’s model in a handoff and the next session runs there.
harnessPoints: Choose the agent tool when you brief the task, then pick a model from that tool’s own catalogue. When several are running, the session list shows which tool each task is on.
A handoff carries more than a note.
The workspace, the plan and its current step, and the notes the previous session left behind all travel to the next one. Whoever picks it up doesn’t rebuild the context.
The record belongs to the work.
Plans, the project wiki, deliverables and notes live in Fleet, not inside one tool. What Claude Code writes down, Codex and dsh can read back.
mobileHeading:
Away from your desk.
Still part of the work.
mobileCopy: An idea doesn’t have to wait until you get home. Start a task from your phone, choose the project and device, and come back when a decision needs you.
mobilePoints: Type a brief, or edit a voice transcription.
See tasks and decisions from paired devices together.
Preview, download or share supported deliverables.
moreHeading:

somewhere to go.
moreCopy: For the work that takes more than a conversation.
moreItems: Keep tasks with their workspace. Reach project files, Git and a terminal when you need to look closer.
Find a previous report, check its version and reference it in the next task.
Use plans and handoff briefs for longer tasks. Schedule recurring work, or wait for a condition before continuing.

faqs: Which AI tools can I use?

Fleet connects to Claude Code, Codex and dsh (DeepSeek Harness, the @deepseek-ai/dsh CLI). Install and configure the tools you want to use. dsh can select models from configured providers; availability depends on those providers and your credentials.
Claw Fleet is free and open source under AGPL-3.0. Your AI tools, model subscriptions and API usage are separate. Usage costs shown in Fleet are estimates.
Does my computer have to stay on?

The machine running the task must stay online. If your phone is paired with Fleet on your computer, keep that computer and Fleet running. You can also deploy fleet webui on another machine that stays online.
Can I speak to it from my phone?
Voice input transcribes speech into text that you can edit before sending. Availability depends on your browser or device speech service and microphone permission. It is not a two-way voice call.

The deliverables view contains files added by an agent or the artifact command. Supported files can be previewed and exported. Mobile relay previews have a 16 MiB limit; use the desktop for larger files.
What happens on a long task?

Fleet supports plans, handoff briefs, schedules and condition-based waits. Handoffs start a fresh session with a brief; they do not provide unlimited context. These workflows depend on setup and agent support.

Fleet monitors local session data. AI tools connect to their configured providers. Phone access uses a relay when paired with a desktop; self-hosting is also possible. Fleet does not include a model account or a hosted cloud workspace subscription.
How do I download in China?

When a China mirror is enabled, select it above. GitHub Releases remains the alternative. Mobile access currently starts from the pairing link in Fleet; these downloads do not include native mobile app packages.
